# Froggit MCP Connector (public links only)

This connector returns public documentation and product links for Froggit,
company memory for people and AI by Frowg Systems. It is not the Froggit
memory server: it does not search, read, or store company memory.

The Froggit memory MCP server is hosted at https://froggit.ai/mcp and
requires an API key issued through Froggit agent onboarding. Its manifest
is https://froggit.ai/.well-known/mcp.json and the agent documentation is
https://froggit.ai/docs/agents. Public Froggit content can be read without
a key at https://froggit.ai/public/search and
https://froggit.ai/api/v1/capsules/public/browse.

Froggit currently publishes no public offers or checkout links. The live
offer catalog is https://froggit.ai/offers.json (empty). For evaluator
access, pilots, and enterprise onboarding: https://froggit.ai/contact

Primary public repo: https://github.com/SunFlash12/forge-cascade-mcp
Docs: https://froggit.ai/docs/agents
OpenAPI: https://froggit.ai/openapi.json
Launch guide: https://github.com/SunFlash12/forge-cascade-mcp/blob/main/LAUNCHGUIDE.md
Install guide: https://github.com/SunFlash12/forge-cascade-mcp/blob/main/llms-install.md

Not Human Search accepted this connector LLM guide, its raw GitHub mirror, the
production proof pack, the gist mirror, and raw gist llms.txt for crawling on
June 1, 2026 UTC. All eight POSTs to https://nothumansearch.ai/api/v1/submit
returned HTTP 201 submitted for crawling after the guide exposed direct buyer
routes and the Enterprise Annual checkout path.
